name: crawlcheck-core
description: The dependency-free modules of the CrawlCheck AI-crawler visibility scanner, extracted from production: robots.txt policy per crawler agent, user-agent group shadowing detection, crawler identification and log-line forgery verification against the operators' published IP feeds, the quotable-content reader an answer engine is judged by, and the markdown-negotiation and agent-surface probes.
author: Emmanuel Orta (https://emmanuelorta.com)
